name: warden-geode
description: Local, evidence-linked Geode preflight reviews inside your editor.

warden.analyzerPath.description: Absolute path to the native warden executable. Local development defaults to this checkout's build/warden.

warden.projectPath.description: Optional absolute mod folder containing mod.json. Otherwise choose a workspace mod or browse.

warden.buildPath.description: Optional absolute folder containing compile_commands.json. Otherwise discover build/ or browse.

warden.analyzeOnSave.description: Reanalyze the selected mod after saved C++ source changes. Unsaved changes invalidate results.

warden.timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum duration of a native analysis run.

warden.catalogPath.description: Prepared local interaction catalog folder. Development defaults to this checkout’s build/interaction-catalog. Catalog setup is required for interaction discovery.

warden.peerProjectPath.description: Remembered advanced manual comparison source root. Remove comparison to select a different peer.

warden.peerBuildPath.description: Remembered compiler settings directory for advanced manual comparison.
